prompt: Create one production sprite atlas for a hand-painted dry-brush gouache Chinese supernatural night market tower defense game. Transparent RGBA background. Restrained old bronze, vermilion, jade, textured folk painting, warm readable highlights, no neon or sci-fi. ROW1 RED LANTERN: tiny red paper lantern petals, glowing warm flame core and fluttering crimson paper ribbons. ROW2 DUMPLING: creamy rice-white round dumpling pearls and curling warm steam with honey-gold specks. ROW3 ZHONG KUI: antique bronze protective arch with angular jade ward-seal brushstrokes, no readable writing. ROW4 COPPER BELL: thin blue-turquoise concentric sound-wave arcs with tiny bronze ringing specks. ROW5 BRAZIER: copper-orange furnace ember ring and short dark-red fire tongues, charcoal flecks. ROW8 LION DANCE: paired red festival ribbons, vermilion confetti and a small gold crest. All eight silhouettes distinct even without color. Art suitable around a plant without obscuring its body, theatrical but restrained. All effects remain entirely within their own cell. True transparency, no painted checkerboard.
